mechanism: The predictive {{think}} process of calculating the probable {{value}} cost of a {{task}} before execution. Two modes: {{heuristic_snap}} for fast rough estimates, {{simulation}} for accurate expensive ones. Outputs a {{bid}} carrying an interval, its coverage, and the reference class it was drawn from. Consumes {{budget}}.
failure_modes: Overconfidence: intervals narrower than the evidence supports.
Anchoring: estimates biased by irrelevant prior information.
Planning Fallacy: systematic underestimation of time and cost.
Allowance exhausted: returns a wide interval a caller may read as a point estimate.
invariants: The interval states the coverage it claims.
The estimate names its reference class, or records that it had none.
The estimator is given its allowance from {{budget}} before starting, and returns on reaching it.

parameters.name: estimation_allowance
parameters.description: Share of the task's budget the estimator may spend.

parameters.name: target_coverage
parameters.description: Coverage the published interval claims, e.g. 0.8 or 0.95.
